name: Browserbase
summary: Fetch pages, search the web and run hosted browser agents on Browserbase, and inspect its browser sessions.

api_key.description: A Browserbase API key (browserbase.com/settings). The project is inferred from the key. Sent in the X-BB-API-Key header.

notes: Fetch reads a page over plain HTTP: no JavaScript, 5 MB maximum (502 above it). Use a browser session for rendered or larger pages.
Agent runs are asynchronous: start one, poll agents.runs.get until COMPLETED, FAILED, STOPPED or TIMED_OUT, and page the transcript with agents.runs.messages.
Creating browser sessions (driven over CDP), contexts, functions, secrets and saved agents are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Fetch a page
endpoints.summary: A page's body, headers and status without a browser, as raw content, markdown, or JSON shaped by a schema.

format.description: raw (default) returns the body unchanged; markdown converts the page; json extracts to schema.

schema.description: JSON Schema of the wanted structure; only used with format json.

allowInsecureSsl.description: Skip TLS certificate verification. Default false.

proxies.description: Send the request through Browserbase proxies. Default false.

contextId.description: A Context whose persisted cookies are sent with the request (a logged-in profile).

notes: Redirects are not followed unless allowRedirects is true. PDFs cannot be converted to markdown or json (400).
402 means the free plan's quota for that format is used up; 429 means too many concurrent fetches.

endpoints.name: Search the web
endpoints.summary: Structured web search results, served by Parallel (default) or Exa.

provider.description: Which search engine serves the request. Default parallel.

mode.description: parallel takes fast or advanced (default advanced); exa takes fast, deep-lite or deep (default fast). Set provider when you set mode.

notes: A read over POST. Limited to 120 requests a minute per project; the price per search depends on provider and mode.

endpoints.name: Run a browser agent
endpoints.summary: Start a hosted agent that completes a natural-language task with web search and a browser.

agentId.description: Run a saved custom agent, using its systemPrompt and resultSchema unless overridden.

resultSchema.description: JSON Schema the run's result should follow.

browserSettings.description: Session settings: context {id, persist}, proxies (true or a list), verified.

variables.description: Named values the agent can use as %name% placeholders: {name: {value, description}}. Not persisted.

pauseWhen.description: When the agent should pause and wait for your input (e.g. a verification code); the run then goes to PAUSED.

notes: A write: the agent acts on live websites and its browser time is billed.
Returns the run id at once; poll agents.runs.get.

endpoints.name: Get an agent run
endpoints.summary: A run's status, result and session.
notes: Status is PENDING, RUNNING, PAUSED, COMPLETED, FAILED, STOPPED or TIMED_OUT.

endpoints.name: List an agent run's messages
endpoints.summary: The run's messages, oldest first, in the AI SDK UIMessage format.

since.description: Id of the last message already received; pass the previous response's nextSince to page or poll.

all.description: Return every message after since, ignoring limit.

endpoints.name: Stop an agent run
endpoints.summary: Ask an in-progress run to wind down to STOPPED.
notes: Stopping a run that has already finished returns a conflict.

endpoints.name: List browser sessions
endpoints.summary: The project's browser sessions, optionally by status or user metadata.

q.description: A query over the sessions' user metadata.

endpoints.name: Get a browser session
endpoints.summary: One session's status, timing, region, context and proxy bytes used.

endpoints.name: Get a session's logs
endpoints.summary: The CDP request and response log of a browser session.
